Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

items.title: A Vulnerability in Zoom Clients Could Allow for Remote Code Execution
items.summary: A vulnerability has been discovered in Zoom Clients that could allow for remote code execution. Zoom is a cloud-based communications platform that allows users to connect via video, audio, chat, and content sharing. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to target meeting participants, execute code without user interaction, steal data, activate cameras or microphones, and install malware.
